en_title: Smile 2 Star Kyle Gallner Wants to Play V in Paramount’s Cyberpunk 2077 Movie
subtitle: 「带我去夜之城」
opus_summary: Kyle Gallner自荐出演派拉蒙《赛博朋克2077》真人电影的男性版V，晒出短发照获得粉丝支持。影片剧情尚未公开，CDPR表示将在适当时候分享更多细节。

paragraphs.en: Smile 2 star Kyle Gallner is making it known that he’s ready and willing to play V in Paramount’s live-action film adaptation of Cyberpunk 2077.
paragraphs.cn: 《危笑2》演员Kyle Gallner公开表示，他已经准备好，也愿意在派拉蒙的《赛博朋克2077》真人改编电影中饰演V。

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk 2077 has come a long way from its roots as a tabletop RPG. Thanks to CD Projekt Red’s video game and its standout expansion, as well as the critically-acclaimed Edgerunners spinoff anime from Studio Trigger, fans of the gritty sci-fi series are eating well.
paragraphs.cn: 从桌面角色扮演游戏起步，到如今的《赛博朋克2077》，这个系列已经走过了很长一段路。CDPR推出的电子游戏及其出色的资料片，加上扳机社制作、广受好评的衍生动画《赛博朋克：边缘行者》，让这个冷峻科幻系列的粉丝大饱眼福。

paragraphs.en: They’re about to get fed even more, as Paramount revealed that it is developing a live-action movie based on the franchise. Thus far, we’re not sure of any plot details, so it’s possible that we could follow V’s adventures with Johnny Silverhand, or Idris Elba’s Solomon Reed before he meets V — or heck, maybe even Edgerunner 2’s Weak Kingsley, for all we know!
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝接下来还能看到更多作品：派拉蒙透露，正在开发一部改编自该系列的真人电影。目前，我们还不清楚任何剧情细节，因此影片可能会讲述V与强尼·银手的冒险，也可能聚焦伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴饰演的所罗门·李德在遇见V之前的经历——甚至说不定会讲《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》中Weak Kingsley的故事，谁知道呢！

paragraphs.en: What we do know is that there’s no shortage of possibilities for this film, and that’s what has fans so excited. One of these fans is none other than actor Kyle Gallner, who is raring to step into Night City as the male version of V.
paragraphs.cn: 我们可以确定的是，这部电影有着丰富的可能性，而这正是粉丝如此兴奋的原因。演员Kyle Gallner也是这些粉丝中的一员，他迫不及待地想以男性版V的身份踏入夜之城。

paragraphs.en: Mere hours after Paramount announced the news on October 8, Gallner posted a photo of himself sporting a close-shaved crop of hair, similar to V’s hairstyle in the game’s marketing materials, along with the caption: “Take me to night city.”
paragraphs.cn: 派拉蒙于10月8日公布消息后仅过了几个小时，Gallner就发布了一张自己的照片。照片中，他留着贴近头皮的短发，与游戏宣传素材中V的发型相似，配文是：「带我去夜之城。」

paragraphs.en: It’s safe to say that fans are pretty enthusiastic about this possible casting, with many already envisioning Gallner alongside Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand.
paragraphs.cn: 可以肯定，粉丝对这一潜在选角相当热情，许多人已经开始想象Gallner与基努·里维斯饰演的强尼·银手同台的画面。

paragraphs.en: Take me to night city. https://t.co/qchq61ZW9P
“Kyle and Keanu. Sounds outstanding,” one wrote, while another said Gallner would be “PERFECT casting.”
paragraphs.cn: 一位粉丝写道：「Kyle和基努，听起来太棒了。」另一位则表示，选Gallner出演会是「完美选角」。

paragraphs.en: “You and Keanu teaming up? I could be on board for that,” another commented.
paragraphs.cn: 还有人评论道：「你和基努搭档？这个我可以支持。」

paragraphs.en: “He’s HIM! Paramount, please consider,” yet another vouched.
paragraphs.cn: 又一位粉丝力挺道：「他就是V本人！派拉蒙，请考虑一下。」

paragraphs.en: For now, details about the movie are being kept under wraps, but CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski promised that more information will come soon.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，电影的具体信息仍处于保密状态，不过CDPR联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski承诺，很快会公布更多消息。

paragraphs.en: "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," he said on X. "We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."
paragraphs.cn: 他在X上表示：「派拉蒙与我们对《赛博朋克》系列有着共同的创作抱负，我们很高兴未来能与他们合作。我们期待在适当的时候分享更多细节。」

paragraphs.en: While they wait for more news, fans can look forward to Edgerunners 2 , set to air on Netflix on October 20, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 在等待更多消息的同时，粉丝还可以期待《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》。该作定于2026年10月20日在Netflix播出。
